audit_result.proof_trace: Proof fails in segment 3 (util_rate > high_kink): weight = (util_rate - high_kink)/(1 - high_kink), and if util_rate > 1.0, weight > 1 so the formula returns a value greater than max_borrow_rate. util_rate can exceed 1.0 because reserve.util_rate() (reserve.move:65-72) applies no cap: as interest accrues, cash_reserve grows (reserve.move:143) while cash is unchanged, and once cash_reserve > cash the denominator (debt + cash - cash_reserve) falls below debt. Neither util_rate() nor calc_interest clamps the result.
audit_result.attack_scenario: At ~95% utilization with a ~285%/yr effective rate and 10% reserve factor, after roughly one year of no repayments cash_reserve exceeds cash, pushing util_rate above 1.0 and the computed borrow rate above max_borrow_rate; a borrower holding a stable-collateral position can sustain this without triggering liquidation, causing the interest rate cap to be silently violated.

PROP-01b-partial3-inv-038.text: Borrow rate must be bounded by max borrow rate to prevent interest rate manipulation DoS.
